name: lumos-barbearia-desktop
description: Lumos Barbearia - app desktop do barbeiro (agenda, clientes, servicos). Dados locais ou no Supabase.

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && electron ." --no-clear
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run test && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.test: rimraf dist-test && esbuild src/shared/entrada-testes.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-test/pacote.cjs --log-level=error && node scripts/testa_regras.mjs && npm run test:dados --silent
scripts.test:dados: npm run test:regras --silent && esbuild src/electron/entrada-testes.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-test/dados.cjs --log-level=error --external:electron && node scripts/testa_dados.mjs
scripts.test:regras: rimraf dist-test && esbuild src/shared/entrada-testes.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-test/pacote.cjs --log-level=error && node scripts/testa_regras.mjs
